newsitem.title: USA: Nextwave to buy Lucent equipment.
newsitem.headline: Nextwave to buy Lucent equipment.

text.p: NextWave Telecom Inc's Nextwave Wireless Inc unit said Monday it would buy $200 million in CDMA-based personal communications services (PCS) equipment and related services from Lucent Technologies Inc.

Lucent will finance the purchase, according to terms of a detailed vendor credit facility, subject to NextWave's fulfillment of certain conditions and execution of further financing documentation, NextWave said.
NextWave will use PCS network equipment, which includes Lucent's 5ESS(R) switches and PCS CDMA base stations, to build networks in New York, Boston and other markets.
Lucent has the option to supply up to another $800 million of infrastructure equipment and related services for use in NextWave's Mid-Atlantic and Midwest markets.
This deal is the latest in a series of strategic agreements for NextWave.

Under a memorandum of understanding, Lucent and NextWave have been conducting field trials with MCI Telecommunications Corp in the Washington area. The companies were testing a PCS demonstration system that was installed at MCI's corporate headquarters. Earlier this year, under a separate contract, MCI committed to buy at least 10 billion minutes of airtime from NextWave.
